info.name: Microsoft Graph Identity Applications Service Principals API

params.name: $top
params.description: Sets the page size of results. Maximum value depends on the API; defaults to 100 for most identity resources.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Skips the specified number of items in the result set.

params.name: $search
params.description: Search items by search phrases. Requires ConsistencyLevel header set to eventual. Supports searching displayName and description.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Filters results using OData filter expressions. Supports eq, ne, not, in, startsWith, endsWith, and lambda operators.

params.name: $count
params.description: Includes a count of the total number of items in a collection alongside the page of data values. Requires ConsistencyLevel header.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Specifies the order of items returned. Use asc for ascending or desc for descending. Example: displayName asc.

params.name: $select
params.description: Selects specific properties to return. Comma-separated list of property names. Example: id,displayName,mail.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Expands related entities inline. For example, expand members of a group or manager of a user.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of service principal objects in the organization. Returns up to 100 objects by default.
